meta.name: Bayou Café
meta.label: DEMO DATA: hand-authored, internally consistent values for one demo site. Fields marked observed come from the local CoStar kit record for property 8035301 (the host building, an apartment community); every other value is invented and marked estimated or derived. Not a measurement, quote or forecast.

inspection.notice: DEMO DATA: hand-authored findings for one demo site. No vision model ran and nothing here is an observation of the property. An on-site inspector must verify every item; fix costs are planning ranges, not quotes.

findings.title: Hood and grease line: Type I hood present, listing not confirmed
findings.description: DEMO DATA: a canopy over the cook line is visible in the scan, but make-up air, fire suppression tags and the last cleaning record are not confirmed. Prior tenants were food users, so a grease line is likely.
findings.verificationStep: Fire-marshal and hood-cleaning inspector: confirm UL 300 suppression tag, hood class and cleaning record.
findings.visibleEvidence: Stainless canopy over the cook line.

findings.title: Grease interceptor: size and location not confirmed
findings.description: DEMO DATA: a food user needs an interceptor; a 1,300 sq ft cafe typically needs a 750 to 1,000 gallon exterior unit shared with the building. Whether the shared unit has capacity is not confirmed.
findings.verificationStep: Plumber and city: locate the interceptor, confirm gallons and last pump-out.
findings.verifyWith: Licensed plumber and City of Houston plan review

findings.title: Ceiling stain above the pickup counter
findings.description: DEMO DATA: a brown stain tile near the counter suggests a past roof or HVAC condensate leak. Active or old is not confirmed.
findings.verificationStep: Inspector: moisture meter above the tile and check the roof drain and condensate line.

findings.title: Two-storey wood frame: floor above the cafe
findings.description: DEMO DATA: the cafe sits under a residential floor (1972 wood frame). Added equipment loads and any wall or opening changes need an engineer's sign-off. No cracking is visible in the scan.

evidence.ref: CoStar kit: wood frame, 2 storeys, built 1972

findings.verificationStep: Structural engineer: review framing over the cafe before relocating walls or adding a heavy walk-in.

findings.title: Floor: worn sealed concrete with two tile patches
findings.description: DEMO DATA: front-of-house floor is sealed concrete with worn patches; kitchen floor is quarry tile with lifted grout near the dish pit. A non-slip, coved floor is normally required behind the counter.
findings.verificationStep: Health inspector or contractor: check coving, slip rating and lifted grout.
findings.visibleEvidence: Lifted grout lines and patched tile.

findings.title: Restrooms: two, accessibility of the second unconfirmed
findings.description: DEMO DATA: two restrooms are labelled in the scan. Clear floor space, grab bars and door swing are not measurable from the scan.
findings.verificationStep: Accessibility consultant: measure turning space, grab bars and lavatory clearance.

findings.title: Entrance: one-inch threshold lip
findings.description: DEMO DATA: the front door shows a raised threshold and a manual door without an automatic operator. ADA requires a maximum half-inch threshold or a ramped transition.
findings.verificationStep: Accessibility specialist: measure threshold height and door force.
findings.visibleEvidence: Raised threshold at the glass door.

findings.title: Electrical: 200 A panel, load for espresso and oven unverified
findings.description: DEMO DATA: a 200 A panel with open breaker slots is visible. A two-group espresso machine, convection oven and dish machine could exceed the suite's share.
findings.verificationStep: Electrician: load calculation, panel directory and 208/240 V circuits for the equipment list.

findings.title: Water heater: tank, about 10 years old
findings.description: DEMO DATA: a 50 gallon tank heater is visible with corrosion at the fittings. A three-compartment sink and dish machine need more recovery than this.
findings.verificationStep: Plumber: read the data plate for age and size, and size recovery for the dish machine.

findings.title: HVAC: two rooftop package units, age and capacity not confirmed
findings.description: DEMO DATA: about 6 rooftop units sit over the cafe wing; two are likely to serve this suite. A food use needs more outside air and cooling than the previous office-style load. Houston's cooling season is long.

evidence.ref: aerial summary, rooftop units over the wing

findings.verificationStep: HVAC contractor: read unit data plates and run a load calculation with kitchen exhaust make-up air.

findings.title: Egress and fire: rear exit door opens onto a lot, no exit sign
findings.description: DEMO DATA: the rear service door has no lit exit sign in the scan and the extinguisher tag is not readable. Sprinkler coverage is assumed, not confirmed.
findings.verificationStep: Fire marshal: confirm exit signage, extinguisher tags, sprinkler coverage and occupant load.
findings.visibleEvidence: Rear door without an illuminated sign.

findings.title: Exterior and roof: flat membrane, ponding near the parapet
findings.description: DEMO DATA: aerial summary shows a flat membrane roof with two light ponding areas over the cafe wing. Roof age is not confirmed.
findings.verificationStep: Roofer: core the membrane, read age and warranty, and check drains before installing exhaust curbs.

findings.title: Walls: washable panel needed behind the counter
findings.description: DEMO DATA: painted drywall behind the counter and dish pit shows scuffing and a bubbled seam. Health code wants smooth, washable surfaces.
findings.verificationStep: Health inspector: confirm wall finish rating and the seam condition.
findings.visibleEvidence: Scuffed paint and a bubbled seam.
